title: Item:Crest of the Scorpion

== Crest of the Scorpion ==
[[File:Crest of the Scorpion orb.png|right|alt=Crest of the Scorpion, focus orb]]
[[File:Crest of the Scorpion.png|right|alt=Crest of the Scorpion, description]]
This crest is etched to show an image of a scorpion.
* {{Bind|no|drops=both}}
* The Crest of the Scorpion works as a key and fits into any Scorpion Socket. Usable in some quests, wilderness adventure areas and assassination challenges.

Acquired by:
* Killing certain monsters
* Looting certain treasure chests
* Pick-up on the dock in front of the Raveneye village in [[The Red Fens]]
* Breaking breakables in Dr. Rushmore's Mansion

Usable in the following assassination challenges:
*'''Dr. Rushmore's Mansion'''
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Behind the Door|Behind the Door]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets|Moving Targets]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets - EPIC|Moving Targets - EPIC]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals|Picture Portals]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals - EPIC|Picture Portals - EPIC]]
